s0001.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, spring, first month, on the jiawu new moon, court audience was waived because of a solar eclipse.
s0001.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, in the first month of spring, on the jiawu new moon, court audience was waived because of a solar eclipse.

s0002.literal: At the time of the solar eclipse, ears appeared on the left and right, and embracing qi above.
s0002.idiomatic: During the eclipse, solar paraselenae appeared to left and right, with a corona above.

s0003.literal: On bingshen day the Yunnan Branch Secretariat said: "After Luodian submitted, it was changed to Puding Prefecture and for more than thirty years was subordinate to Yunnan Province.
s0003.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Yunnan branch secretariat said, "After Luodian submitted, it was changed to Puding Prefecture and for more than thirty years was subordinate to Yunnan Province.

s0004.literal: Now the Luodian Pacification and Assuagement Commission has newly been created and subordinated to Hunan Province; this is inconvenient; we request it be abolished, and its territory again be subordinated to Yunnan Province.
s0004.idiomatic: Now the Luodian pacification and assuagement commission has newly been created and subordinated to Hunan Province; this is inconvenient; we request it be abolished and its territory again be subordinated to Yunnan Province.

s0006.literal: On wuxu day Qing Prefecture suffered famine; grain was issued from Ling Prefecture — forty-seven thousand eight hundred shi — to relieve it.
s0006.idiomatic: On wuxu day Qing Prefecture suffered famine; 47,800 shi of grain was issued from Ling Prefecture to relieve it.

s0007.literal: On jihai day Director of the Astronomy Bureau Guo Shoujing was ordered concurrently to superintend the Directorate of Waterways; eight posts were still established — vice director, assistant director, recorder, and clerk.
s0007.idiomatic: On jihai day Director of the Astronomy Bureau Guo Shoujing was ordered concurrently to superintend the directorate of waterways; eight posts were still established — vice director, assistant director, recorder, and clerk.

s0008.literal: The Eight Crafts Office had formerly had six officials by regulation; now it was divided into left and right offices, with two posts added.
s0008.idiomatic: The Eight Crafts Office had formerly had six officials by regulation; now it was divided into left and right offices, with two posts added.

s0009.literal: On gengzi day Jiangxi Branch Secretariat left vice chancellor Gao Xing said: "In Jiangxi and in Ting and Zhang of Fujian, bandits have risen year after year; the common people have entered the mountains to escape; we request an imperial order to summon and instruct them to return to their occupations.
s0009.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jiangxi branch secretariat left vice chancellor Gao Xing said, "In Jiangxi and in Ting and Zhang of Fujian, bandits have risen year after year; the common people have entered the mountains to escape; we request an imperial order to summon and instruct them to return to their occupations.

s0010.literal: Fujian salt revenues have both a transport commission and four salt commissioner's offices; if now a supervisory office is established to oversee salt revenues exclusively, and wine tax revenues are all returned to the regular offices, that would be convenient.
s0010.idiomatic: Fujian salt revenues have both a transport commission and four salt commissioner's offices; if now a supervisory office is established to oversee salt revenues exclusively, and wine tax revenues are all returned to the regular offices, that would be convenient.

s0011.literal: Fujian silver and iron likewise each had supervisory offices established — this too is redundant; we request they be abolished.
s0011.idiomatic: Fujian silver and iron likewise each had supervisory offices established — this too is redundant; we request they be abolished.

s0012.literal: " An edict approved all of this.
s0012.idiomatic: An edict approved all of this.

s0013.literal: Merchants were forbidden privately to take gold and silver to sea.
s0013.idiomatic: Merchants were forbidden privately to take gold and silver to sea.

s0014.literal: On renyin day, because of the Wuping earthquake, last year's tax of four thousand five hundred thirty-six ingots was remitted in full; this year a measured levy was collected — only two thousand five hundred sixty-nine ingots were levied.
s0014.idiomatic: On renyin day, because of the Wuping earthquake, last year's tax of 4,536 ingots was remitted in full; this year a measured levy was collected — only 2,569 ingots were levied.

s0015.literal: On guimao day yuhanchi Arigh was ordered to establish a relay station at Yong Prefecture for the convenience of grain supplies, while light troops were returned to garrison Siming Prefecture.
s0015.idiomatic: On guimao day yuhanchi Arigh was ordered to establish a relay station at Yong Prefecture for the convenience of grain supplies, while light troops were returned to garrison Siming Prefecture.

s0016.literal: The Han Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan's son Yudi was made to succeed to his office.
s0016.idiomatic: The Han Celestial Master Zhang Zongyan's son Yudi was made to succeed to his office.

s0017.literal: The director of the Liyong Directorate was promoted to rank 3a.
s0017.idiomatic: The director of the Liyong Directorate was promoted to rank 3a.

s0018.literal: On jiachen day an edict said: "For school lands of prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, their annual income may be self-administered; aside from the spring and autumn sacrificial offerings, it shall support teachers and students and scholars without means.
s0018.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict said, "For school lands of prefectures and counties in Jiangnan, their annual income may be self-administered; aside from the spring and autumn sacrificial offerings, it shall support teachers and students and scholars without means.

s0019.literal: As for lands of examination-candidate estates, the yield shall be verified and submitted to the government.
s0019.idiomatic: As for lands of examination-candidate estates, the yield shall be verified and submitted to the government.

s0020.literal: " On yisi day Prince Shidu'er was granted one thousand taels of gold.
s0020.idiomatic: On yisi day Prince Shidu'er was granted 1,000 taels of gold.

s0021.literal: On bingwu day Henan and Fujian branch secretariat officials requested an edict using Chinese; an order directed that Mongolian language instruct Henan and Chinese instruct Fujian.
s0021.idiomatic: On bingwu day Henan and Fujian branch secretariat officials requested an edict using Chinese; an order directed that Mongolian language instruct Henan and Chinese instruct Fujian.

s0022.literal: The Henan Pacification Commission was abolished; Bianliang, Xiangyang, Henan, Nanyang, and Guide were all subordinated to Henan Branch Secretariat.
s0022.idiomatic: The Henan pacification commission was abolished; Bianliang, Xiangyang, Henan, Nanyang, and Guide were all subordinated to Henan branch secretariat.

s0023.literal: De'an, Hanyang, and Xinyang of Huguang Province were again cut away and subordinated to Jinghu North Circuit; Qi and Huang to Huai West Circuit; and all three pacification commissions of Huai East Circuit were subordinated to Henan Province.
s0023.idiomatic: De'an, Hanyang, and Xinyang of Huguang Province were again cut away and subordinated to Jinghu North Circuit; Qi and Huang to Huai West Circuit; and all three pacification commissions of Huai East Circuit were subordinated to Henan Province.

s0024.literal: Its Jinghu North Circuit Pacification Commission had formerly governed Chen, Yuan, Li, Jing, Gui, and Changde; these were directly subordinated to Huguang Province.
s0024.idiomatic: Its Jinghu North Circuit pacification commission had formerly governed Chen, Yuan, Li, Jing, Gui, and Changde; these were directly subordinated to Huguang Province.

s0025.literal: Following the request of Gemman Military-Civil Assuagement Commissioner Song Zixian, an edict instructed the various cave Cat Miao of Pingfa, Dayongyan, Zijiang, Piling, Tanxi, Jiubao, and other unsubmitting places.
s0025.idiomatic: Following the request of Gemman military-civil assuagement commissioner Song Zixian, an edict instructed the various cave Cat Miao of Pingfa, Dayongyan, Zijiang, Piling, Tanxi, Jiubao, and other unsubmitting places.

s0026.literal: On wushen day the moon transgressed Jupiter and the left horn of Xuanyuan.
s0026.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon transgressed Jupiter and the left horn of Xuanyuan.

s0027.literal: On jiyou day Xing'an and Yixing, two counties of Xing Prefecture, suffered famine; five thousand shi of rice was issued in relief.
s0027.idiomatic: On jiyou day Xing'an and Yixing, two counties of Xing Prefecture, suffered famine; 5,000 shi of rice was issued in relief.

s0028.literal: The record-keeping offices of Nanxiong, Shaozhou, and Huizhou circuits were abolished.
s0028.idiomatic: The record-keeping offices of Nanxiong, Shaozhou, and Huizhou circuits were abolished.

s0029.literal: On renzi day relay-station households from Huan Prefecture to Chicheng reported famine; notes were issued per person to relieve them.
s0029.idiomatic: On renzi day relay-station households from Huan Prefecture to Chicheng reported famine; notes were issued per person to relieve them.

s0030.literal: On guichou day the Four Guest Storehouses were abolished and the Hall of Joint Audience restored; five supervisory offices for weaving section-cloth were initially established.
s0030.idiomatic: On guichou day the Four Guest Storehouses were abolished and the Hall of Joint Audience restored; five supervisory offices for weaving section-cloth were initially established.

s0031.literal: Eight Banners commander-in-chief Liu Delu said: "Fifteen stockades of newly submitted cave Miao — we request government offices be established to govern them.
s0031.idiomatic: Eight Banners commander-in-chief Liu Delu said, "Fifteen stockades of newly submitted cave Miao — we request government offices be established to govern them.

s0032.literal: " An edict established the Chenmeng-Lantu Military-Civil Assuagement Commission.
s0032.idiomatic: An edict established the Chenmeng-Lantu military-civil assuagement commission.

s0033.literal: Jiangxi Branch Secretariat officials Bayan and Alawadin said: "Mengshan yields twenty-five thousand taels of silver annually in levies.
s0033.idiomatic: Jiangxi branch secretariat officials Bayan and Alawadin said, "Mengshan yields 25,000 taels of silver annually in levies.

s0034.literal: By the original regulation, for each tael of silver refined, five dou of corvée labor and land rent was remitted; now the people's strength grows daily exhausted; for each tael it is proposed to remit one shi.
s0034.idiomatic: By the original regulation, for each tael of silver refined, five dou of corvée labor and land rent was remitted; now the people's strength grows daily exhausted; for each tael it is proposed to remit one shi.

s0035.literal: " The Emperor said: "You heavily burden my people — how are the people to live!
s0035.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "You heavily burden my people — how are the people to live!

s0037.literal: On bingchen day the cave Miao of Bozhou, suspecting harm from household registration, fled and hid; an edict was issued summoning and gathering them.
s0037.idiomatic: On bingchen day the cave Miao of Bozhou, suspecting harm from household registration, fled and hid; an edict was issued summoning and gathering them.

s0038.literal: Acting Bozhou Military-Civil Assuagement Commissioner Yang Hanying was made pacification commissioner of the frontier regions including Shaoqing, Zhen, and Nanping, acting Bozhou military-civil pacification commissioner, and commander of ten thousand households governing troops at Bozhou and other places; he was still granted a tiger tally.
s0038.idiomatic: Acting Bozhou military-civil assuagement commissioner Yang Hanying was made pacification commissioner of the frontier regions including Shaoqing, Zhen, and Nanping, acting Bozhou military-civil pacification commissioner, and commander of ten thousand households governing troops at Bozhou and other places; he was still granted a tiger tally.

s0039.literal: On renxu day the succeeding Han Celestial Master Zhang Yudi was summoned to court.
s0039.idiomatic: On renxu day the succeeding Han Celestial Master Zhang Yudi was summoned to court.

s0040.literal: Second month, on the jiazi new moon, the Jinzhu chieftain Saolü presented twenty-seven horses and twenty-seven felts each; following his request to reduce tribute horses from his jurisdiction, an edict was issued summoning and instructing him.
s0040.idiomatic: Second month, on the jiazi new moon, the Jinzhu chieftain Saolü presented 27 horses and 27 felts each; following his request to reduce tribute horses from his jurisdiction, an edict was issued summoning and instructing him.

s0041.literal: Newly submitted Black Miao were granted jackets and sent back; they were ordered to present the finest cinnabar and realgar their land produced — if none, then stop.
s0041.idiomatic: Newly submitted Black Miao were granted jackets and sent back; they were ordered to present the finest cinnabar and realgar their land produced — if none, then stop.

s0042.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Earth Altar, and Four Seas on the Emperor's behalf.
s0042.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the Sacred Peaks and Streams, Earth Altar, and Four Seas in the Emperor's stead.

s0043.literal: On yichou day one month's grain was granted to famine victims of Longshan in Huizhou and Zhonghe and other counties in Li Prefecture.
s0043.idiomatic: On yichou day one month's grain was granted to famine victims of Longshan in Huizhou and Zhonghe and other counties in Li Prefecture.

s0044.literal: On dingmao day he hunted in the near suburbs.
s0044.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.

s0045.literal: Palace guards receiving monthly rations and Mongol troops receiving grain because of food hardship were ordered still to be overseen by the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
s0045.idiomatic: Palace guards receiving monthly rations and Mongol troops receiving grain because of food hardship were ordered still to be overseen by the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

s0046.literal: On jisi day the moon transgressed Net.
s0046.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon transgressed Net.

s0047.literal: Grain from Tong Prefecture and Hexiwu was issued to relieve famine victims of Dong'an, Gu'an, Ji Prefecture, and Baodi County.
s0047.idiomatic: Grain from Tong Prefecture and Hexiwu was issued to relieve famine victims of Dong'an, Gu'an, Ji Prefecture, and Baodi County.

s0048.literal: The lash to the back was forbidden.
s0048.idiomatic: The lash to the back was forbidden.

s0049.literal: On gengwu day Woluosi received the submission of thirty-one cave chieftains including Shengmao of Sang Prefecture and Guzhou of Luodi, comprising one hundred twenty-nine thousand three hundred twenty-six households under their jurisdiction; they came to court bearing tribute.
s0049.idiomatic: On gengwu day Woluosi received the submission of 31 cave chieftains including Shengmao of Sang Prefecture and Guzhou of Luodi, comprising 129,326 households under their jurisdiction; they came to court bearing tribute.

s0050.literal: On renshen day an order directed envoys dispatched separately to the various circuits to release prisoners below capital crimes.
s0050.idiomatic: On renshen day an order directed envoys dispatched separately to the various circuits to release prisoners below capital crimes.

s0052.literal: On yihai day the Ten-thousand-household Office commanding Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han troops was established; a silver seal was issued; it commanded six thousand troops in all.
s0052.idiomatic: On yihai day the ten-thousand-household office commanding Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han troops was established; a silver seal was issued; it commanded 6,000 troops in all.

s0053.literal: Quanfu Grand Minister Yiheimishi, former Deng Prefecture commander of ten thousand households Shi Bi, and Fujian Branch Secretariat right vice chancellor Gao Xing were all made grand councillors of the Fujian Branch Secretariat, commanding troops on campaign against Java, using five hundred large and small seagoing vessels and twenty thousand soldiers.
s0053.idiomatic: Quanfu grand minister Yiheimishi, former Deng Prefecture commander of ten thousand households Shi Bi, and Fujian branch secretariat right vice chancellor Gao Xing were all made grand councillors of the Fujian branch secretariat, commanding troops on campaign against Java, using 500 large and small seagoing vessels and 20,000 soldiers.

s0054.literal: On wuyin day the Left and Right Campaign Armies commander-in-chief headquarters were established — four commanders-in-chief and two vice commanders-in-chief.
s0054.idiomatic: On wuyin day the left and right campaign armies commander-in-chief headquarters were established — four commanders-in-chief and two vice commanders-in-chief.

s0055.literal: Four darughachi of ten-thousand-household offices, four commanders of ten thousand households each, eight vice commanders of ten thousand households, and four pacification commissioners — each bore a tiger tally.
s0055.idiomatic: Four darughachi of ten-thousand-household offices, four commanders of ten thousand households each, eight vice commanders of ten thousand households, and four pacification commissioners — each bore a tiger tally.

s0056.literal: An edict added Grand Guardian rank to Goryeo King Wang Chun and still bestowed the title of meritorious minister.
s0056.idiomatic: An edict added Grand Guardian rank to Goryeo King Wang Chun and still bestowed the title of meritorious minister.

s0057.literal: An edict directed that among those who followed Prince Atu in rebellion, Duoluodai was given to Kuolijisi, Tiediechu to Arigh, Chaorechi to Yuedimishi, and Hema to Yiheimishi, to serve in the army and redeem themselves.
s0057.idiomatic: An edict directed that among those who followed Prince Atu in rebellion, Duoluodai was given to Kuolijisi, Tiediechu to Arigh, Chaorechi to Yuedimishi, and Hema to Yiheimishi, to serve in the army and redeem themselves.

s0058.literal: An edict also directed that among those who followed Prince Heda in rebellion: Nadaer to Prince Zhennan's household, Nieqilai to Helahesundarah's household, Atu to the Prince of Yunnan's household, Duaertu to Arigh's household, Balidai to Yuedimishi's household, and Woluoluo and Hulidai to the Eastern Sea.
s0058.idiomatic: An edict also directed that among those who followed Prince Heda in rebellion: Nadaer to Prince Zhennan's household, Nieqilai to Helahesundarah's household, Atu to the Prince of Yunnan's household, Duaertu to Arigh's household, Balidai to Yuedimishi's household, and Woluoluo and Hulidai to the Eastern Sea.

s0059.literal: Grain from charity and government granaries was issued to relieve famine victims of De Prefecture, Qihe, Qingping, and Tai'an Prefecture.
s0059.idiomatic: Grain from charity and government granaries was issued to relieve famine victims of De Prefecture, Qihe, Qingping, and Tai'an Prefecture.

s0060.literal: On gengchen day Yuerlu and others said: "Nasir al-Din Amir, Xindu, and Wang Juji were partisans of Sangge and acted lawlessly without restraint; paper currency, appointments, salt revenues, and wine taxes — nothing was left unchanged and unsettled.
s0060.idiomatic: On gengchen day Yuerlu and others said, "Nasir al-Din Amir, Xindu, and Wang Juji were partisans of Sangge and acted lawlessly without restraint; paper currency, appointments, salt revenues, and wine taxes — nothing was left unchanged and unsettled.

s0061.literal: Those charged with auditing accounts in Jiangnan were all pressed with urgent payment deadlines; the people came to selling wives and daughters, and harm reached kin and neighbors.
s0061.idiomatic: Those charged with auditing accounts in Jiangnan were all pressed with urgent payment deadlines; the people came to selling wives and daughters, and harm reached kin and neighbors.

s0062.literal: At Weiyang and Qiantang the suffering was most severe; more than five hundred lives were lost without cause.
s0062.idiomatic: At Weiyang and Qiantang the suffering was most severe; more than 500 lives were lost without cause.

s0063.literal: At first officials and commoners still doubted whether these matters came from the state; now they know the Emperor lovingly cherishes the people — yet that the people were driven to such extremes was truly the doing of Sangge and his vicious faction; none do not wish to eat their flesh.
s0063.idiomatic: At first officials and commoners still doubted whether these matters came from the state; now they know the Emperor lovingly cherishes the people — yet that the people were driven to such extremes was truly the doing of Sangge and his vicious faction; none do not wish to eat their flesh.

s0064.literal: We deliberated: these three men have already suffered punishment; we request they be sentenced according to statute to answer to the realm.
s0064.idiomatic: We deliberated: these three men have already suffered punishment; we request they be sentenced according to statute to answer to the realm.

s0066.literal: Yayimishi received one thousand four hundred thirty-six unregistered households and requested they be placed under the Eastern Palace; an edict ordered them to till fields.
s0066.idiomatic: Yayimishi received 1,436 unregistered households and requested they be placed under the Eastern Palace; an edict ordered them to till fields.

s0067.literal: On xinsi day, following the request of Privy Council officials including Anba, at Xiangyang six hundred thirty-seven Qarluq households of Quxiantalin were given farm implements and seed grain to farm and live by their labor.
s0067.idiomatic: On xinsi day, following the request of privy council officials including Anba, at Xiangyang 637 Qarluq households of Quxiantalin were given farm implements and seed grain to farm and live by their labor.

s0068.literal: On dinghai day Wang Weihe was made convenient general commander of the twenty-four places including Gongchang, concurrently prefect of Gongchang, and still bore a tiger tally.
s0068.idiomatic: On dinghai day Wang Weihe was made convenient general commander of the 24 places including Gongchang, concurrently prefect of Gongchang, and still bore a tiger tally.

s0069.literal: The Censorate — Yuerlu, Cui Yu, and others — said: "Feng Zizhen and Liu Daoyuan pointed out the crimes of Sangge's colleagues; an edict ordered secretariat and censorate officials together with Dong Wenyong, Liu Mengyan, and others to deliberate.
s0069.idiomatic: The censorate — Yuerlu, Cui Yu, and others — said, "Feng Zizhen and Liu Daoyuan pointed out the crimes of Sangge's colleagues; an edict ordered secretariat and censorate officials together with Dong Wenyong, Liu Mengyan, and others to deliberate.

s0070.literal: One matter: among Hanlin officials who compiled the 《Stele of Sangge's Auxiliary Governance》, surveillance commissioner Yan Fu has recently been dismissed from office; as for the rest, we request the sage decision.
s0070.idiomatic: One matter: among Hanlin officials who compiled the 《Stele of Sangge's Auxiliary Governance》, surveillance commissioner Yan Fu has recently been dismissed from office; as for the rest, we request the sage decision.

s0071.literal: " The Emperor said: "Let the dead be unmentioned; as for those who live, punishment cannot be forgiven.
s0071.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Let the dead be unmentioned; as for those who live, punishment cannot be forgiven.

s0072.literal: " Taibuhua and others were requested as envoys to Burma; an edict ordered them remotely conferred as left vice chancellors.
s0072.idiomatic: Taibuhua and others were requested as envoys to Burma; an edict ordered them remotely conferred as left vice chancellors.

s0073.literal: At court it was deliberated that a Minister of Revenue should handle affairs, with his deputy serving as a bureau director.
s0073.idiomatic: At court it was deliberated that a minister of revenue should handle affairs, with his deputy serving as a bureau director.

s0075.literal: On wuzi day falconry at Hangzhou was forbidden.
s0075.idiomatic: On wuzi day falconry at Hangzhou was forbidden.

s0076.literal: On jichou day Jupiter transgressed Xuanyuan's major star.
s0076.idiomatic: On jichou day Jupiter transgressed Xuanyuan's major star.

s0077.literal: On gengyin day Xuanzheng Court officials said that Nianzhenshuna, supreme Buddhist president of the various routes, should be conferred Grand Master of Palace Attendance and commander-in-chief pacification commissioner of the Tibetan regions and other places.
s0077.idiomatic: On gengyin day Xuanzheng Court officials said that Nianzhenshuna, supreme Buddhist president of the various routes, should be conferred Grand Master of Palace Attendance and commander-in-chief pacification commissioner of the Tibetan regions and other places.

s0078.literal: An order directed three hundred forty-seven scattered Badur households to tenant idle fields at Yidu; cattle, seed, and farm implements were granted, and the government built dwellings for them.
s0078.idiomatic: An order directed 347 scattered Badur households to tenant idle fields at Yidu; cattle, seed, and farm implements were granted, and the government built dwellings for them.

s0079.literal: On renchen day the Shandong Surveillance Commission reported: "Within De Prefecture, spring brought drought and frost; summer again brought torrential flooding; famine victims ate goosefoot and tree leaves; we request relief.
s0079.idiomatic: On renchen day the Shandong surveillance commission reported, "Within De Prefecture, spring brought drought and frost; summer again brought torrential flooding; famine victims ate goosefoot and tree leaves; we request relief.

s0080.literal: " An order followed the Dongping precedent, issuing from nearby government granaries according to persons.
s0080.idiomatic: An order followed the Dongping precedent, issuing from nearby government granaries according to persons.

s0081.literal: Third month, jiawu day: an edict ordered Tuohusi and Nongduchixiliemen dispatched to the Hedunnusun frontier, to consult with imperial son-in-law Kuolijisi on implementing garrison farming.
s0081.idiomatic: Third month, jiawu day: an edict ordered Tuohusi and Nongduchixiliemen dispatched to the Hedunnusun frontier, to consult with imperial son-in-law Kuolijisi on implementing garrison farming.

s0082.literal: On jihai day Privy Council officials said: "For campaigning against Jurchen Nalige, it was deliberated to select one thousand from three thousand newly submitted troops at Hesi Han.
s0082.idiomatic: On jihai day privy council officials said, "For campaigning against Jurchen Nalige, it was deliberated to select 1,000 from 3,000 newly submitted troops at Hesi Han.

s0083.literal: " An edict first mobilized five hundred men; the Branch Secretariat was to provide boats and grain; the Eastern Campaign Pacification Commission was still established.
s0083.idiomatic: An edict first mobilized 500 men; the branch secretariat was to provide boats and grain; the Eastern Campaign Pacification Commission was still established.

s0084.literal: On renyin day Censor-in-chief Yuerlu and others memorialized: "Recently surveillance censor Shang Hu recommended men who formerly served in the imperial editorial and censorial bureaus and were trusted by public esteem but are now outside — such as Hu Zhiyuan, Yao Sui, Wang Yun, Lei Ying, Chen Tianxiang, Yang Gongyi, Gao Dao, Cheng Wenhai, Chen Yi, and Zhao Juxin, ten men — who should be summoned and placed in the Hanlin Academy as advisers.
s0084.idiomatic: On renyin day censor-in-chief Yuerlu and others memorialized, "Recently surveillance censor Shang Hu recommended men who formerly served in the imperial editorial and censorial bureaus and were trusted by public esteem but are now outside — such as Hu Zhiyuan, Yao Sui, Wang Yun, Lei Ying, Chen Tianxiang, Yang Gongyi, Gao Dao, Cheng Wenhai, Chen Yi, and Zhao Juxin, ten men — who should be summoned and placed in the Hanlin Academy as advisers.

s0085.literal: " The Emperor said: "I do not yet know them well; wait until they are summoned and then report.
s0085.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "I do not yet know them well; wait until they are summoned and then report.

s0086.literal: " On bingwu day central secretariat officials said: "The capital region suffers consecutive famine; this year's land rent should be remitted.
s0086.idiomatic: On bingwu day central secretariat officials said, "The capital region suffers consecutive famine; this year's land rent should be remitted.

s0087.literal: Shangdu, Longxing, Pingluan, Hejian, and Baoding — five circuits whose provisioning burdens exceed other circuits — should have this year's public levies remitted.
s0087.idiomatic: Shangdu, Longxing, Pingluan, Hejian, and Baoding — five circuits whose provisioning burdens exceed other circuits — should have this year's public levies remitted.

s0088.literal: River ponds in the Han regions under the Court of Imperial Entertainments — aside from those supplying the Imperial Kitchen — should have their prohibitions relaxed so the people may take food conveniently.
s0088.idiomatic: River ponds in the Han regions under the Court of Imperial Entertainments — aside from those supplying the Imperial Kitchen — should have their prohibitions relaxed so the people may take food conveniently.

s0090.literal: On dingwei day Nasir al-Din Amir, for embezzling more than one hundred thirty thousand ingots of official and private notes, and Xindu, for compelling collection of unpaid debts until five hundred twenty persons were killed — all suffered execution.
s0090.idiomatic: On dingwei day Nasir al-Din Amir, for embezzling more than 130,000 ingots of official and private notes, and Xindu, for compelling collection of unpaid debts until 520 persons were killed — all suffered execution.

s0091.literal: Wang Juji, though without illicit gains, the Emperor because he shared Xindu's wickedness had him executed as well.
s0091.idiomatic: Wang Juji, though without illicit gains, the Emperor because he shared Xindu's wickedness had him executed as well.

s0092.literal: The Central Secretariat and Censorate jointly fixed thirteen grades of corruption offenses — five involving perversion of law, eight not involving perversion of law; offenses meriting death were reported upward.
s0092.idiomatic: The central secretariat and censorate jointly fixed 13 grades of corruption offenses — five involving perversion of law, eight not involving perversion of law; offenses meriting death were reported upward.

s0094.literal: On wushen day, because the people of Weining, Chang, and other prefectures suffered famine, two thousand ingots of notes were issued in relief.
s0094.idiomatic: On wushen day, because the people of Weining, Chang, and other prefectures suffered famine, 2,000 ingots of notes were issued in relief.

s0095.literal: On jiyou day Grand Agriculture Commissioner and Court of Imperial Entertainments deputy commissioner concurrently superintending the Imperial Kitchen Directorate Tiege, and Hanlin Academician Grand Preceptor and Bureau of Transmission commissioner concurrently managing the Imperial Stud Directorate Lazhen, were both made grand councillors of the central secretariat, concurrently retaining their former posts.
s0095.idiomatic: On jiyou day grand agriculture commissioner and Court of Imperial Entertainments deputy commissioner concurrently superintending the Imperial Kitchen Directorate Tiege, and Hanlin Academician Grand Preceptor and Bureau of Transmission commissioner concurrently managing the Imperial Stud Directorate Lazhen, were both made grand councillors of the central secretariat, concurrently retaining their former posts.

s0096.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Right vice chancellor He Rongzu is ill; grand councillor Maishuding has long held his post; we request they be excused from signing documents, receiving only salary, yet deliberating on central secretariat affairs.
s0096.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Right vice chancellor He Rongzu is ill; grand councillor Maishuding has long held his post; we request they be excused from signing documents, receiving only salary, yet deliberating on central secretariat affairs.

s0098.literal: Arigh was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and Liang Andula associate administrator.
s0098.idiomatic: Arigh was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and Liang Andula associate administrator.

s0099.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Yixibus and Bafan-Luodian have each had a pacification commission established, yet a commander-in-chief headquarters was also re-established; the territory is very narrow while offices are many; the two commissions and commander headquarters should be merged into one.
s0099.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Yixibus and Bafan-Luodian have each had a pacification commission established, yet a commander-in-chief headquarters was also re-established; the territory is very narrow while offices are many; the two commissions and commander headquarters should be merged into one.

s0100.literal: " An edict approved this, and also ordered Yixibus and Si and Bozhou likewise subordinated to Huguang Province; Luodian restored to Yunnan; Woluosi and others, pacification commissioners of Bafan-Luodian, were all made commanders-in-chief and pacification commissioners of Bafan-Shunyuan and other places, bearing tiger tallies.
